14-DATABASE-SCHEMA.dbml

Полный документИсходный формат: DBMLОткрыть исходный файл ↗
Project MarginPilot {
  database_type: 'PostgreSQL'
  Note: 'Схема по подтверждённым сценариям и реконструированному контракту'
}

Table cabinet {
  id uuid [pk, not null, note: 'Внутренний UUID кабинета MarginPilot']
  name text [not null, note: 'Внутреннее название кабинета']
  ozon_client_id text [not null, unique, note: 'Внешний идентификатор Ozon']
  ozon_api_key_encrypted bytea [not null, note: 'Только шифртекст; ключ шифрования хранится вне БД']
  seller_name text [not null]
  inn text [not null]
  performance_client_id text [note: 'NULL, если рекламный API не подключён']
}

Table manager {
  user_id uuid [pk, not null]
  last_name text [not null]
  first_name text [not null]
  middle_name text
  email text [not null]
  phone text
  account_status text [not null, default: 'active']
  created_at timestamptz [not null, default: `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`]

  indexes {
    (`lower(email)`) [unique, name: 'manager_email_ci_uq']
  }

  checks {
    `account_status IN ('active', 'disabled')`
  }
}

Table sku {
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  seller_sku text [not null]
  ozon_product_id text
  name text
  thumbnail_url text

  indexes {
    (cabinet_id, seller_sku) [pk]
  }
}

Table change_batch {
  batch_id uuid [pk, not null]
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  created_by uuid [not null]
  action_type text [not null]
  status text [not null, default: 'accepted']
  idempotency_key text [not null]
  request_fingerprint text [not null]
  created_at timestamptz [not null, default: `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`]

  indexes {
    (cabinet_id, idempotency_key) [unique]
    (batch_id, cabinet_id, action_type) [unique]
  }

  checks {
    `action_type IN ('change_price', 'add_to_promotion', 'remove_from_promotion')`
    `status IN ('accepted', 'verifying', 'confirmed', 'partial', 'unconfirmed')`
  }
}

Table change_item {
  batch_id uuid [not null]
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  seller_sku text [not null]
  action_type text [not null]
  target_price numeric(14,2)
  promotion_id text
  include_below_threshold boolean [not null, default: false]
  api_result text [not null, default: 'pending']
  api_error text
  verification_result text [not null, default: 'pending']
  actual_price numeric(14,2)
  actual_participation boolean
  verified_at timestamptz

  indexes {
    (batch_id, seller_sku) [pk]
    (batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku) [unique]
    (cabinet_id, seller_sku) [name: 'change_item_sku_idx']
  }

  checks {
    `target_price IS NULL OR target_price > 0`
    `actual_price IS NULL OR actual_price >= 0`
    `api_result IN ('pending', 'reported_success', 'rejected', 'unknown')`
    `verification_result IN ('pending', 'matched', 'mismatch')`
    `(action_type = 'change_price' AND target_price IS NOT NULL AND promotion_id IS NULL) OR (action_type = 'add_to_promotion' AND target_price IS NOT NULL AND promotion_id IS NOT NULL) OR (action_type = 'remove_from_promotion' AND target_price IS NULL AND promotion_id IS NOT NULL)`
    `action_type <> 'remove_from_promotion' OR include_below_threshold = false`
  }
}

Table calculation_snapshot {
  batch_id uuid [not null]
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  seller_sku text [not null]
  captured_at timestamptz [not null, default: `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`]
  evaluated_price numeric(14,2)
  current_price numeric(14,2)
  unit_cost numeric(14,2) [not null]
  planned_markup_rate numeric(10,6) [not null]
  payroll_per_unit numeric(14,2) [not null]
  planned_logistics_cost_per_unit numeric(14,2) [not null]
  planned_review_cost_per_unit numeric(14,2) [not null]
  planned_ad_cost_per_sale numeric(14,2) [not null]
  commission_rate numeric(8,6) [not null]
  tariff_per_unit numeric(14,2) [not null]
  participation_status boolean
  boost_level text
  boost_price_limit numeric(14,2)
  economic_threshold numeric(14,2) [not null]
  planned_profit_per_unit numeric(14,2) [not null]

  indexes {
    (batch_id, seller_sku) [pk]
  }

  checks {
    `evaluated_price IS NULL OR evaluated_price > 0`
    `current_price IS NULL OR current_price >= 0`
    `unit_cost >= 0`
    `planned_markup_rate >= 0`
    `payroll_per_unit >= 0`
    `planned_logistics_cost_per_unit >= 0`
    `planned_review_cost_per_unit >= 0`
    `planned_ad_cost_per_sale >= 0`
    `commission_rate >= 0 AND commission_rate <= 1`
    `tariff_per_unit >= 0`
    `boost_price_limit IS NULL OR boost_price_limit >= 0`
    `economic_threshold >= 0`
  }
}

Table decision_log {
  decision_id bigint [pk, increment]
  batch_id uuid [not null]
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  seller_sku text [not null]
  user_id uuid [not null]
  decided_at timestamptz [not null, default: `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`]
  decision text [not null]

  indexes {
    (batch_id, seller_sku) [unique]
    decided_at [name: 'decision_log_decided_at_idx']
  }

  checks {
    `decision = 'include_below_threshold'`
  }
}

Table plan_version {
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  seller_sku text [not null]
  valid_from timestamptz [not null]
  planned_profit_per_unit numeric(14,2) [not null]
  source_batch_id uuid [note: 'NULL для начальной версии плана']

  indexes {
    (cabinet_id, seller_sku, valid_from) [pk]
    (source_batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku) [unique]
  }
}

Table sale {
  sale_id uuid [pk, not null, note: 'Внутренний ID MarginPilot']
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  source_sale_id text [not null, note: 'Устойчивый ключ строки при импорте из Ozon']
  seller_sku text [not null]
  sold_at timestamptz [not null]
  quantity integer [not null]
  revenue numeric(14,2) [not null]
  cost_of_goods_sold numeric(14,2) [note: 'Проектное поле: себестоимость проданных единиц из 1С']

  indexes {
    (cabinet_id, source_sale_id) [unique]
    (cabinet_id, seller_sku, sold_at) [name: 'sale_sku_period_idx']
  }

  checks {
    `quantity > 0`
    `cost_of_goods_sold IS NULL OR cost_of_goods_sold >= 0`
  }
}

Table actual_expense {
  expense_id uuid [pk, not null, note: 'Внутренний ID MarginPilot']
  cabinet_id uuid [not null]
  source_system text [not null]
  source_expense_id text [not null]
  seller_sku text [not null]
  incurred_at timestamptz [not null]
  expense_type text [not null]
  amount numeric(14,2) [not null]

  indexes {
    (cabinet_id, source_system, source_expense_id) [unique]
    (cabinet_id, seller_sku, incurred_at) [name: 'actual_expense_sku_period_idx']
  }

  checks {
    `source_system IN ('one_c', 'ozon')`
    `expense_type IN ('commission', 'logistics', 'reviews', 'advertising')`
  }
}

Ref: sku.cabinet_id > cabinet.id

Ref: change_batch.cabinet_id > cabinet.id
Ref: change_batch.created_by > manager.user_id

Ref: change_item.(batch_id, cabinet_id, action_type) > change_batch.(batch_id, cabinet_id, action_type)
Ref: change_item.(cabinet_id, seller_sku) > sku.(cabinet_id, seller_sku)

Ref: calculation_snapshot.(batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku) > change_item.(batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku)

Ref: decision_log.user_id > manager.user_id
Ref: decision_log.(batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku) > change_item.(batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku)

Ref: plan_version.(cabinet_id, seller_sku) > sku.(cabinet_id, seller_sku)
Ref: plan_version.(source_batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku) > change_item.(batch_id, cabinet_id, seller_sku)

Ref: sale.(cabinet_id, seller_sku) > sku.(cabinet_id, seller_sku)
Ref: actual_expense.(cabinet_id, seller_sku) > sku.(cabinet_id, seller_sku)
